title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 75
description: Ten questions on Psalms 75: thanks for God's near Name, a warning to the arrogant, and the cup in Yahweh's hand.

questions.text: Why do they give thanks, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "We give thanks, for your Name is near."

questions.text: When the earth and its inhabitants quake, what does the speaker firmly hold?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: "The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars."

questions.text: What did the speaker say to the arrogant?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says: "I said to the arrogant, 'Don't boast!'"

questions.text: With what are the wicked told not to speak?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: "Don't speak with a stiff neck."

questions.text: After saying exaltation does not come from the east, west or south, who does verse 7 say is the judge?
questions.explanation: Verses 6-7 say exaltation does not come from the east, west or south, "But God is the judge."

questions.text: What does verse 7 say God does?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: "He puts down one, and lifts up another."

answers.text: He puts down one and lifts up another
He leaves the earth to men
He sleeps and does not see

questions.text: What is in Yahweh's hand, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says that in Yahweh's hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices.

questions.text: Who drink the cup to its very dregs?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says: "Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs."

questions.text: To whom will the speaker sing praises in verse 9?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says: "I will sing praises to the God of Jacob."

questions.text: Whose horns shall be lifted up, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says the horns of the wicked will be cut off, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.
